preconditions.description: Length of string s is between 1 and 10^5.
Length of string t is between 1 and 10^5.
Product of lengths of s and t does not exceed 10^7.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() or c == '?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s consists of lowercase letters and question marks.
String t consists of lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of occurrences of string t in string s after replacing question marks.
